How to use this book
Some terms are used in all the lessons. This is what they mean.
Let us read
This appears at the beginning of a reading passage. It means you should read the lines 
that follow.
Read, think and answer
This normally appears after the reading passage. Here you have to read the questions 
given, think about the answer, which is based on what you have read and then write the 
answer.
Let us write
This appears towards the end of the lesson. Here you should write about what you have 
been asked to write on.
Let us talk
You have to speak the words or sentences given here out loud.
Check your answers
These are answers to questions you have answered after reading the lesson. Do not look 
at them for help. Only check to see if you are correct or wrong.
